text:
laura: quick check — weights for `llama-3x2-v2` are in gs://redwood-weights/llama3x2/v2/ and model passes smoke infer, but our tokenizer CI shows a 1-token shift when using the chat system sentinel. did anyone hit this before?

josh: i saw something similar on a diffed onboarding last month. do you have an example prompt + token counts?

katie: pasted minimal repro from CI logs: 
```
SYSTEM: 
<|system|>You are helpful.
USER: Hello
```
CI tokenized -> [101, 200, 300, 400] (len 4)
Local tokenized -> [101, 999, 200, 300, 400] (len 5)
Looks like an extra sentinel token inserted on local run.

ivan: hmm — that 999 looks like our legacy special token id (SENTINEL_ALT). Maybe the tokenizer config in weights bundle still points to the older `special_tokens_map.json`?

laura: i checked the bundle: `tokenizer_config.json` includes `bos_token: "<|bos|>"` and a `special_tokens_map` file is missing on GCS (we upload via CI). gcs path: gs://redwood-weights/llama3x2/v2/tokenizer/* — can someone validate that the artifact upload included the final `merges.json` and `special_tokens_map.json`?

ciara: @laura i pulled the bucket — there is `vocab.json` and `merges.txt` but no `special_tokens_map.json`. uploads looked green though. deploy-bot: upload-verify status: SUCCESS (artifact-size: 120MB).

josh: that explains it. default fallback injects SENTINEL_ALT when map missing. two options: (1) re-upload special_tokens_map.json and keras-style config, or (2) change runtime to prefer `tokenizer.json` inside the wheel which has explicit `added_tokens`. which is faster for you?

katie: re-upload is low-risk. i can assemble the `special_tokens_map.json` from the repo's tokenizer profiles — need ownership of the bucket write.

ivan: also note config validation flagged `add_bos: true` in `model_config.json` while our chat runtime expects system sentinel to be explicit and not auto-prefixed. that mismatch causes double-BOS in some paths. we should run the config validator script: `tools/validate_tokenizer_and_serving_config.py --weights gs://...` before marking onboarded.

laura: agree. next steps: katie to upload special_tokens_map, ivan to run validator, josh to gate the rollout in canary so we don't hit prod. i'll create a PR with the missing map and a short README note about the `add_bos` flag behavior.

katie: will upload in ~30m. pushing a tiny tar with `special_tokens_map.json` + README to gs. i'll comment the PR link here.

josh: once uploaded i'll run a quick canary config that forces `use_bos_from_prompt=false` for this model in canary. :thumbsup:

laura: thanks — also adding a quick unit to tokenizer-tests: assert that tokenized(system + user) length == tokenized(system) + tokenized(user) when `add_bos` is false. prevents regressions.

ciara: small nit — can we add a short line in onboarding checklist: "verify special_tokens_map present on weights bucket"? saved me once.

laura: done. added to checklist doc and PR description.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout for `llama-3x2-v2` at +1h with fallback to `llama-3x2-v1` if token-delta > 2 tokens.

ivan: logging note — if you see token offsets in telemetry, the scoped metric is `tokenizer.delta.tokens` with tags {model, env}. use that to confirm fix.

laura: great. updating onboarding ticket and closing this thread once katie confirms upload. thanks all!
